verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a Research Agent effort slider (Fastest, Fast, Balanced, Smart, Smartest) that you set before sending a question. Scope can be steered by stating filters in the query, which Elicit applies automatically, and skills let you direct how the agent approaches a task. Since the story allows steering before execution, this covers its core. Missing for 10: any evidence of adjusting effort or scope while a run is executing, a depth control distinct from the effort tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these controls work.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can steer the depth, effort, and scope of a research run before or while it executes

citations.quote: Every Research Agent session runs at an effort level, which you set from the slider in the prompt box before you send your question.
click it to open the slider and move between Fastest, Fast, Balanced, Smart, and Smartest
The simplest way to filter is to just say what you want in your Research Agent query. Elicit will automatically detect and apply the right filter.
A skill is a set of instructions you can hand to Elicit's agent so it approaches a task a particular way.
